description: Anatomical mesh set for Human Performance Explorer

coordinateSystem.origin: ground plane at y=0, model centred on x=0
coordinateSystem.note: Muscles, skeleton and body shell share one baked transform and are mutually aligned. Fiber and cell are separate microscopic scenes and do not share this space.
